title: The Storm Channel
logline: A cartographer tracks an antique colonial distress echo echoing inside an ion storm's magnetic corridor, racing to recover the lost land charter before an extraction trust jams the signal.

roles.description: An astrophysicist who maps deep solar magnetic channels; stubborn, patient, tracking faint radio anomalies across the cluster.
Represents displaced families whose ancestral homesteads were expropriated; passionate, meticulous, searching for legal proof of title.
A heavy security cruiser deployed by the extraction trust to patrol the ion front and silence unauthorized broadcasts.
The mineral conglomerate currently leasing the contested planetary plains under a disputed provincial charter.
The coalition of pioneer descendants seeking restitution for lost ancestral land claims.
A listening platform positioned on the rim of the primary ion storm front.
A long-range telemetry buoy anchored in a neighboring star system.
A planetary archive vault in an adjacent sector where historical land titles are verified and registered.

public_situation: Pioneer descendants demand reparations at {role:records_sanctuary}, claiming their families' original planetary land grants were unlawfully erased.
private_truth: {role:frontier_cartographer} detected an un-corrupted colonial survey broadcast trapped inside the ion storm's magnetic channel that proves the settlers' title.

beats.public_change: {role:frontier_cartographer} aligns long-baseline receiver dishes at {role:storm_observatory} to isolate the storm-trapped signal.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to extract the cryptographic decryption keys before corporate agents seal the observatory on false safety charges.
missions.private_fact: She initially sold preliminary wave data to {role:extraction_trust} before realizing the recording proved the homesteaders' case.

beats.public_change: The trapped radio echo shifts into a neighboring system as the magnetic eye migrates across orbital lanes.

missions.reason: She needs the pilot to jump to the adjacent system and triangulate the reflective wave bounce before atmospheric noise degrades the audio.
missions.private_fact: The original recording contains the voice of her own grandfather declaring the colony charter before he disappeared.

beats.public_change: Autonomous corporate jamming probes flood the relay sector with static, blocking the trapped signal's downlink.

missions.reason: He needs the jamming picket destroyed immediately so the raw telemetry can download before the storm channel disperses into deep space.
missions.private_fact: He promised his dying mother that he would restore the family homestead name to the public ledger.

beats.public_change: The uncorrupted audio file is downloaded, but requires heavy magnetic shielding to transport through deep-space interference.

missions.reason: He needs cryogenic Faraday containment units purchased from industrial markets and brought to the archive vault to preserve the data core.
missions.private_fact: He liquidated the homestead league's legal defense fund to pay for the purchase.

beats.public_change: {role:corridor_enforcer} intercepts traffic on the archive approach, broadcasting an order to surrender all salvage data.

missions.reason: He needs the trust's gunboat broken so the survey evidence can be entered into the judicial registry under armed protection.
missions.private_fact: The corporate captain hails mid-combat offering two hundred thousand credits in bearer scrip to hand over the recording.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot breaks the corporate gunboat and enters the historic recording into the archives.
resolutions.summary: The restored colonial survey verifies the original deeds. {role:extraction_trust} is forced to pay back-royalties, restoring ancestral titles to {role:homestead_league}.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary broke through corporate jammers to recover a century-old survey echo trapped in the ion storm.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the corporate settlement and hands over the audio core.
resolutions.summary: {role:extraction_trust} incinerates the recording and secures permanent mining leases. {role:charter_advocate} is disgraced, and {role:homestead_league} is evicted from the basin.

consequences.public_summary: Word leaked that a pilot took mining syndicate gold to erase the last recording of the colony founders.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the contract, or corporate jammers scatter the signal.
resolutions.summary: The storm channel collapses before the broadcast can be recorded. {role:extraction_trust} keeps the contested plains, and the pioneer claims are dismissed for lack of evidence.

loose_threads.detail: The telemetry buoy at {role:border_relay} contains a hardwired frequency lock tuned to corporate frequencies six months before the storm hit.
The mineral lease for {role:extraction_trust} carries an indemnity clause covering forged historical surveys held by an offshore debt trust.
The original dismissal of the homestead deeds was signed by a colonial registrar whose identification card was duplicated across two sectors.

radio_hooks: Demonstrators gather at {role:records_sanctuary} demanding access to historical planetary surveys.
{role:extraction_trust} warns that uncertified radio claims inside ion storms are 'acoustic mirages'.
Storm front shifts outward; communications blackouts reported across three star systems.

voice_direction.frontier_cartographer: Measured, pedantic, and deeply focused on atmospheric resonance. Speaks of century-old radio waves bouncing in the storm with quiet reverent fascination.
voice_direction.charter_advocate: Passionate, fast-talking, and chronically anxious. Every sentence sounds like a closing argument before a judge who has already made up their mind.
